'''BlasTech Industries''' was one of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] top three arms manufacturers, with [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn]] and [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub]] being its main competitors. BlasTech was the market leader in the manufacture of personal energy weapons and light artillery. BlasTech was most famous for its [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] weapons, though the company also manufactured a number of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] weapons including [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]], [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]] and [[Missile/Legends|missiles]].

==History==
[[File:BTCH01AB.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A BlasTech advertisement]]
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], BlasTech officials wished to hire security to protect a key weapons shipment from [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. An individual dispatched an associate of theirs to provide security.<ref name="Business Opportunity">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Underworld Trading|Business Opportunity}}</ref>

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], BlasTech provided the Republic's [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] with their state-of-the-art weaponry. When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] rose to power, BlasTech was pressured to sign an exclusive agreement with the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]], but corporate leadership held firm and maintained a standing policy of selling weaponry to anyone and everyone who had the [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. As such, many BlasTech weapons were found in [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] hands during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Despite its relatively notable independence from the total Imperial control which dominated and seized major galactic companies at the time, BlasTech's famed [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11 blaster rifle]] became the standard Imperial sidearm and the favored weapon of the dreaded Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]. Many other BlasTech designs were also integrated into the Imperial arsenal and remained even into the days of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] and [[Second Imperium]], kept for their versatility and durability. BlasTech Corporation was a division of BlasTech Industries, which manufactured the personal and military blaster weapons.
